about:
# Forever Loot Sparkles

![ForeverLootSparkles logo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/svengabr/ForeverLootSparkles/main/media/logo.png)

Keeps the loot sparkle on quest items switched on in **World of Warcraft: Forever**, so you don't walk past them.

Graphics presets turn the sparkle off. This addon turns it back on at login and whenever a graphics change resets it. There is nothing to set up.

![Forever Loot Sparkles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/svengabr/ForeverLootSparkles/main/media/gallery/01-overview.jpg)

![Survives graphics presets](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/svengabr/ForeverLootSparkles/main/media/gallery/02-presets.jpg)

## Want more sparkles?

This addon only does quest items. For herbs, ore and other objects, use one of these:

| Addon | What it adds |
| --- | --- |
| [Forever Loot Sparkles : Herbs & Ores](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/forever-loot-sparkles-herbs-ores) by N3zr0k | Sparkles on herbs, ore veins, quest objects and corpses with loot, each in a color you pick. Needs this addon installed. |
| [Lueur](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/lueur) | Lights up ore veins, herbs, chests and quest objects as you get close. Ten effects, sparkles and a light beam among them. |

Versions 1.2.0 to 1.3.1 had herb and ore sparkles built in. They broke self-cast and left empty nameplates on dead mobs, so 2.0.0 removed them and put your interact key settings back.

## Turning it off again

Untick the checkbox under **Esc > Options > AddOns > Forever Loot Sparkles**, restart the game (`/reload` is not enough), then remove the addon.

Removing the addon alone does not switch the sparkle off, because WoW saves the setting itself. If the addon is already gone, type this and restart the game:

```
/console outlineModeShowLootEffectWhenDisabled 0
```

## Good to know

- The game shows either the sparkle or the outline on quest items, never both.
- The game decides which objects sparkle. Addons can't pick.
- Quest givers sparkle too. The game uses one setting for both, so there is no way to keep the sparkle on quest items and drop it on NPCs.

## About me

I'm Sven. I've been a software developer for over 20 years, and I write and maintain my World of Warcraft addons in my free time. They are free and open source, and they will stay that way.

Found a bug or have an idea? Open an [issue](https://github.com/svengabr/ForeverLootSparkles/issues) or send me a DM on [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/members/conoar).

## Support

The addon is free and always will be. If it made your game a bit nicer, you can [buy me a coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/conoar) or send something via [PayPal](https://paypal.me/svengabr).

releases.notes: - The addon's creator has a "Forever Loot Sparkles Creator" line in the tooltip.

- The addon is back to what it started as: it only keeps the game's loot sparkle on quest items switched on.
- Removed: the sparkles on ore veins, herbs, corpses with loot and quest objects, and their four checkboxes. They relied on Blizzard's soft targeting, which caused friendly spells cast without a target to land on someone nearby instead of you, left empty nameplates over dead mobs and showed interact icons above objects. For herb and ore sparkles, try [Lueur](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/lueur).
- On the first login after the update, the soft targeting settings the addon changed (**Enable Interact Key**, the interact icons on objects, the interact range and the soft target nameplate) go back to what you had before 1.2.0. If you changed one of them yourself in the meantime, yours stays.

- The addon no longer touches your outline mode, so the Self Highlight outline around your character works again. It only keeps the loot sparkle switched on. Up to 1.3.0 it switched the outline mode off; pick it again under Options > Graphics if you want it back.
- Fixed: searching the game's Options (e.g. for "name" or "display") with the addon enabled raised `ADDON_ACTION_FORBIDDEN … IsUserOAuthed()` and blamed ForeverLootSparkles. The restart reminder is no longer a line in the options panel; it is printed in chat when you switch the sparkles off.
- Fixed: the addon no longer switches on all of **Interact Key Icons**, which put icons on every chair and NPC. It only keeps the icons on world objects, which the herb and ore sparkle needs; the rest goes back to what you had before 1.2.0.
- Fixed: **Enable Interact Key** and the icons on world objects are no longer switched back on at every login and `/reload`. The addon turns them on when the sparkles start and when you tick a sparkle checkbox; if you switch them off afterwards, they stay off (and nodes and corpses don't sparkle).

- Corpses that still hold loot for you sparkle as you approach them after the fight, bosses included (the game's own loot sparkle left boss corpses out). New checkbox "Corpses with loot" (on; off if you had switched all sparkles off before).
- Fewer Lua errors blaming ForeverLootSparkles ("GetAuraDataByIndex(): Auras cannot be accessed when secret while tainted", seen on level up): the soft targeting console variables are now only written when their value actually changes.
- Fixed: killed mobs kept a nameplate with 0% health until they were looted. The soft target nameplate is now switched off when combat starts, so nodes don't sparkle during combat.
